overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation where the Board discussed agenda items before or out of the times listed on its agenda, since the law only requires the meeting to start at the posted time. The Chair-conduct allegations were declined as not violations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to follow the order and timing of agenda items, which listed times for discussing each topic, and discussed items early or out of order.
allegations.key_passage: We find therefore that the Board's failure to adhere to the indicated times on the notice for the discussion of individual agenda items did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Chair denied the complainant an opportunity to respond to complaints against his property during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: These allegations, even if proven true, would not violate the Open Meeting Law, thus we decline to review them.
